structure.partition: training class prototypes plus separate exhaustive minimum within-group negative A/B-gradient cosine candidate
structure.selection: calibration correct then lower parameter count; incumbent retained on ties
structure.capacity_control: wide-single has exactly aggregate expert parameters, router additional
structure.exposure_control: same extra presentations when balanced class counts and batch size divide both datasets
structure.prospective_gate: positive paired held-task quality and no claimed all-cost gain without crossover

evaluation.unit: authored request; seeds rerun same requests
evaluation.target: execute predicted fixed skill on raw payload and compare independent golden
evaluation.composition: public step decomposition, not learned planning

cost.storage: weights, optimizer, source, index, shared pretrained base, runtime, evidence separately
cost.latency: warm end-to-end CPU per request with actual encoder, routing, executor; no batch-only speed claim
cost.failed_candidates: preserve checkpoints, scores and incurred training work
cost.network_gain: requires measured benefit beyond successful transport

limitations: Finite standard-library operation vocabulary and authored instructions, not open code synthesis.
Skill executors are deterministic supplied programs; learned content is selection and project bindings.
Grouping is domain specialization, not proof of emergent biological cell types.
Chronological corrections are constructed, not observed production histories.
Migration continues adapter training on fixed real pretrained embeddings, not training the encoder.
